meta.name: lean-ux-canvas
meta.description: Guide teams through Lean UX Canvas v2. Use when framing a business problem, surfacing assumptions, and defining what to learn next.

copy.tagline: 引导团队梳理业务问题与假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要结构化地定义产品方向和学习目标。
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams through business problems and assumptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a structured way to define product direction and learning goals.

howto.what: 引导团队填写 Lean UX Canvas v2 的 8 个格子，从业务问题出发，逐步明确用户、假设、实验，帮助团队聚焦学习而非盲目开发。
howto.when: 当你需要梳理业务问题、暴露团队假设、或把模糊想法转化为可测试的假设时触发。例如启动新功能、重构现有项目、或对齐跨职能团队时。

say.text: 帮我用 Lean UX Canvas 分析用户流失问题。
say.note: 技能会引导你填写 8 个格子。

say.text: 我们有个新 AI 产品想法，用 Lean UX Canvas 梳理一下。
say.note: 技能会从业务问题开始提问。

say.text: 领导想要一个聊天机器人，但问题可能是工单太多。
say.note: 技能会帮你把解决方案重新框定为问题。

howto.what_en: Guide teams through filling the 8 boxes of the Lean UX Canvas v2, starting from a business problem, surfacing assumptions, and defining experiments to learn next.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to frame a business problem, surface assumptions, or turn vague ideas into testable hypotheses. Use for new initiatives, reframing projects, or aligning cross-functional teams.

say_en.text: Run a Lean UX Canvas for onboarding drop-off.
say_en.note: Skill will walk through all 8 boxes.

say_en.text: Use Lean UX Canvas to frame a new AI product idea.
Leadership wants a chatbot, but problem is ticket volume.
